# Alert Service

## Purpose
The Alert Service module provides the business logic and RESTful endpoints for managing alerts. it enables creating, updating, filtering, and real-time distribution of alerts via WebSockets.

## Structure
- **Controller**: REST API endpoints for Alert management (`AlertController`).
- **Service**: Business logic for alert operations (`AlertService`).
- **Repository**: Data access layer using JPA (`AlertRepository`).
- **Requests**: Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for creating, updating, and filtering alerts.
- **WebSocket**: Real-time alert notifications (`AlertsSocketHandler`).

## Key Operations
- `createAlert`: Creates a new alert and persists it.
- `updateAlert`: Updates an existing alert.
- `getAllAlerts`: Lists alerts based on filters with pagination support.

## Real-time Notifications
The module includes a WebSocket handler that allows clients to subscribe to alerts and receive real-time updates.

## Sequence Diagram (Create Alert)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant Controller as AlertController
    participant Service as AlertService
    participant Repository as AlertRepository
    participant DB as Database

    Client->>Controller: POST /Alert/createAlert (AlertCreate)
    Controller->>Service: createAlert(alertCreate, securityContext)
    Service->>Repository: merge(alert)
    Repository->>DB: Save Alert
    DB-->>Repository: OK
    Repository-->>Service: Merged Alert
    Service-->>Controller: Alert
    Controller-->>Client: Alert
```
